scientific_integrity: All-size analytic martingale and product-spin proof; exact-rational finite-state checker and independent tilted spectral checks; no computer-based infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Zero reciprocal coupling only, continuous-time finite stationary ring with N>=4; no finite-time law or higher entropy cumulants. Existing model and known N=3/mean results credited. Publication priority is best-knowledge and independently unaudited.
title: A unique four-spin anomaly in entropy-current fluctuations of a nonreciprocal kinetic Ising ring
